node.title: XR rank-five one-defect quartic kernels have few nonbasis locators
node.statement: In a rank-five extension-list branch with u=1, the normalized kernel is a four-dimensional subspace W of quartics. A four-set T is a kernel nonbasis exactly when its split locator L_T lies in W. If W has no common evaluation root on an N-point domain, a triple-completion count and the sharp split-cubic locator line bound give at most floor((C(N,3)+(N-2)(N-4))/4) nonbasis four-sets. Official agreement blocks therefore contain at most 42/42/20 nonbases and at least 168/168/50 bases. This is a source-to-flat refinement, not an XR payment.
